Suzuka 3D ships third-party textures and models in `public/assets/` (high-quality tier only). Every file there is CC0 or CC-BY; the exact source, licence and hash of each is recorded in `public/assets-manifest.json`. Reference material that is only *looked at* (photographs, seating charts, aerial tiles) is not distributed and is not listed here.
